title: AI-Assisted Exploratory Causal Modeling of Cumulative Advantage in Small-N Domains

contributions.purpose: 提出小-N 高共线域的双方法因果建模框架
contributions.mechanism: 前向选择回归+LOOCV 预测 + DAG 引导结构建模与反事实模拟
contributions.evaluation: N=51 州级观测;参与人数模型 LOOCV R²≥0.8,Top-N 模型多数 R²≥0.5(最低 0.493)
contributions.source_quote: We introduce an AI-assisted dual-method computational approach that combines LOOCV-based regression for predictive robustness with DAG-guided structural modeling for transparent assumption testing.

contributions.purpose: 识别青少年高尔夫精英表现的主要预测因子
contributions.mechanism: 多元回归 + 控制分析(序贯残差)
contributions.evaluation: 参与基数与 PGA 赛事存在解释 >85% 表现方差;气候(日照)在控制后基本被中介,财力仅对 Top50 女生显著
contributions.source_quote: Participant base and PGA Tour presence explain over 85% of performance variance. PGA presence consistently shows an independent association, while climate and income associations are largely mediated.

contributions.purpose: 反事实模拟给出政策含义
contributions.mechanism: 在 DAG 假设下模拟增设 PGA 赛事/提升参与
contributions.evaluation: 假设依赖:办 PGA 赛事收益最大,参与项目中等,定向补助托举临界选手
contributions.source_quote: Assumption-dependent simulations suggest hosting PGA events yields the largest performance gains

notes: accept。作者非匿名(Zach Huang, The Overlake School 高中生 + ChatGPT-5)。方法学诚实、反复自限定为“exploratory / assumption-dependent / adjusted associations”而非严格因果。trade-off/负结果:N=51 州级观测极小样本、高共线,高 AF... 即高层级组样本稀(承认 overfitting 风险,靠 LOOCV+前向选择缓解);气候(日照)与 LPGA 赛事未入模型。核心张力:标题称“Causal Modeling”但 N=51 观测数据难支撑因果,论文自己降级为相关+假设性反事实(合理披露)。AI 披露:AI 辅助假设生成/建模,数据人工爬取。数据无造假红旗。
